median_single_edit_similarity_rule: the median similarity between a product and the ion it was edited from, over the single-edit run, unrounded. Reported because it says what one edit does; no selection rule uses a threshold
root_rule: the ion whose body is closest to the median body size for that core, then canonical SMILES

rule_meanings.exploration: always selects the product least similar to the starting ion
rule_meanings.local: always selects the product most similar to the starting ion
rule_meanings.random: selects any new valid product, with no distance preference

similarity_is_measured_against: the ion the walk started from, not the ion of the current round
